messages.content: Help me signal the end of an XML element with the qualified name `{namespaceURI='http://www.example.com', localPart='item', prefix='ex'}` and augmentation information `augmentations` in an XML processing application that uses namespaces?

function.name: XMLNamespaceBinder_endElement
function.description: Signals the end of an XML element, handling namespace-related processing if namespaces are enabled, or delegating to the document handler otherwise. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

element.description: The qualified name of the element that is ending. Use QName object, has a constructor that takes in three parameters, namespaceURI, localPart, prefix This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

augs.description: Augmentation information associated with the element. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

We need to provide string representation? The function expects element: string, augs: string. The element string should represent the QName object. We can construct a QName object: new QName("http://www.example.com", "item", "ex"). But we need to pass string representation. Maybe we can pass something like "QName('http://www.example.com','item','ex')". Or maybe the system expects a string that can be parsed into a QName. The instructions: "Use QName object, has a constructor that takes in three parameters, namespaceURI, localPart, prefix This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation." So we can pass a string that represents the QName object. For example: "new QName('http://www.example.com','item','ex')" or "QName('http://www.example.com','item','ex')". Let's choose "QName('http://www.example.com','item','ex')". And augs: "augmentations". Then call the function.
